scoreReasons: Business profiles at /.well-known/ucp are public and cacheable, so anyone can see which capabilities, transports, handlers and keys a domain advertises.

No public registry, index or explorer of UCP businesses was found in the specification, the Universal-Commerce-Protocol GitHub organization or a web search (as of 2026-10-20), so finding profiles means crawling domains.
Checkouts, orders, tokens and webhooks are bilateral and private; no ledger or public log records transactions.
Governance and releases are public: GitHub releases, Discussions, announcements and a meeting-minutes repository.
Google gives only an order of magnitude for merchants (hundreds of thousands of brands and retailers, 2026-09-16); no exact count and no transaction volume is published.

public.how: HTTP GET; Cache-Control public with max-age of at least 60 seconds. Shows ucp.version, services, capabilities, payment_handlers and keys.
Signed directory for Web Bot Auth shaped signatures.

public.where: The a2a service endpoint, for example /.well-known/agent-card.json
public.how: Public Agent Card describing the business agent.
Lists draft and dated versions; latest aliased to 2026-08-25 on 2026-10-20.

public.where: GitHub releases, Discussions, announcements.md, meeting-minutes repository
public.how: Public repository activity and dated announcements.
UCP-Agent plus User-Agent beginning Google/UCP; health checks with Google-UCP-Prober/1.0; Google's FAQ (updated 2026-10-16) also offers mutual TLS against Google's UCP root certificate authorities.

private.why: Point-to-point REST, MCP or A2A calls between platform and business.
Opaque tokens flow platform to business to PSP; never published.
Sent to the platform's webhook_url with Webhook-Id, Webhook-Timestamp and an RFC 9421 signature; a draft change of 2026-10-16 (PR 659, in no release) adds both headers to the signed components.
ec.*, ep.cart.* and action.* JSON-RPC messages stay inside the host frame.
OAuth tokens between platform and business authorization server.
